name: Luna Harbor
intro: Find a little room for possibility.

en: A personal relationship with the stars
Western natal astrology, sun-sign horoscopes and tarot are distinct practices. This app offers a space to discuss your interests; it does not calculate a natal chart or perform a tarot reading.
An intention, in your own words
Write one intention and one achievable action. Moon-themed journaling is optional; the app does not claim a ritual can guarantee love, money or health.

name: Willow Moon
intro: A thoughtful moment, just for you.

en: Your own way of looking at the stars
This app uses Western astrology as a conversation theme. The UK has many beliefs; seasonal customs and modern astrology do not form one shared British ritual system.
A seasonal pause
Notice what is changing around you and write one thing you would like to nurture. This is a journaling suggestion, not a historical Druidic or other sacred rite.

name: Southern Star
intro: A little space beneath a very big sky.

en: Your own tradition
Choose the traditions that matter to you. South African communities have diverse beliefs; a country or birthday does not determine your religion.
A moment of gratitude
If it fits your own practice, take a quiet moment to thank someone who has supported you. This is an optional reflection, not an ancestral consultation.
af: Kies die tradisies wat vir jou saak maak. Suid-Afrikaanse gemeenskappe het uiteenlopende oortuigings; jou land of verjaarsdag bepaal nie jou geloof nie.
As dit by jou eie gebruik pas, bedank iemand wat jou ondersteun het. Dit is opsionele nadenke, nie ʼn voorouerraadpleging nie.

name: Siam Dao
intro: A quiet moment for a brighter day.

en: Birth-day traditions
Some Thai practices connect the day of birth with colours and Buddha images. Customs vary; the app does not calculate auspicious times or prescribe worship.
Kindness today
If meaningful to you, make time for a simple act of kindness. Merit-making is a religious practice, not a guaranteed way to change an outcome.
th: ความเชื่อเรื่องวันเกิด
บางประเพณีไทยเชื่อมโยงวันเกิดกับสีและพระประจำวันเกิด แต่ละชุมชนมีธรรมเนียมต่างกัน แอปนี้ไม่คำนวณฤกษ์หรือกำหนดวิธีบูชา
ความเมตตาในวันนี้
หากสอดคล้องกับความเชื่อของคุณ ลองทำความดีเล็ก ๆ การทำบุญเป็นการปฏิบัติทางศาสนา ไม่ใช่การรับประกันผลลัพธ์

name: Nyota Path
intro: Your questions. Your path. Your pace.

en: Many communities, many traditions
Kenya has many cultural and religious communities. This app offers zodiac-themed reflection; it does not claim a single Kenyan divination system.
A grounded intention
Write down one intention for the day and one practical step toward it. Add a personal prayer only if it belongs to your own practice.
sw: Kenya ina jamii nyingi za kitamaduni na kidini. Programu hii hutoa tafakari kuhusu nyota; haidai kuwa kuna mfumo mmoja wa utabiri wa Kenya.
Andika lengo moja la siku na hatua moja ya kulifikia. Ongeza sala binafsi ikiwa tu ni sehemu ya imani yako.

en: Different zodiac traditions
Western horoscopes and Chinese zodiac traditions are distinct. Chinese New Year does not start on January 1; this app does not assign an animal using a simple calendar-year shortcut.
A wish, a next step
Write a hope for the coming season and a realistic action you can take. Family customs and religious practices remain your personal choice.
fil: Magkaiba ang Kanluraning horoscope at Chinese zodiac. Hindi Enero 1 ang simula ng Chinese New Year; hindi gumagamit ang app ng simpleng taon lamang para tukuyin ang hayop.
Isulat ang iyong pag-asa at isang makatotohanang hakbang na kaya mong gawin. Nasa iyo ang pagpili ng tradisyon at paniniwala.

name: Orion Naija
intro: Make room for the question on your mind.

en: Respecting distinct traditions

Nigeria has diverse traditions. Ifá is a Yoruba divination tradition with its own trained practitioners; it is not interchangeable with Western astrology and this app does not perform an Ifá consultation.
Reflection in your own words
Set aside a moment to reflect on a question, then choose a practical next step. Prayer or other rituals are optional and belong to your own beliefs.

name: Byeol Saju
intro: A little pause between life’s chapters.

en: Four pillars, not a sun sign
Saju uses the year, month, day and hour of birth. An accurate chart needs calendar and time conventions. This preview does not calculate the four pillars or compatibility.
A new chapter
At a new beginning, write what you hope to nurture and what you can change. This reflection is not a prediction or a prescribed Korean ritual.
ko: 사주는 태어난 연·월·일·시를 살펴봅니다. 정확한 명식에는 달력과 시간 기준이 필요합니다. 이 미리보기는 사주나 궁합을 계산하지 않습니다.
새로운 시작에 키우고 싶은 것과 바꿀 수 있는 것을 적어 보세요. 이 성찰은 예언이나 정해진 한국 의례가 아닙니다.

name: Serendib Stars
intro: A gentle space for your next question.

en: Lagna and auspicious times
Some Sri Lankan traditions consult horoscopes and auspicious times. A full chart requires birth time, place and a calculation method. This preview does not calculate a lagna or nekath.
Personal observance
Choose a quiet reflection that fits your own faith. Buddhist, Hindu, Muslim, Christian and other Sri Lankan traditions should not be treated as one ritual system.
si: ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ ඇතැම් සම්ප්‍රදායන් කේන්දර සහ සුබ වේලාවන් භාවිත කරයි. සම්පූර්ණ කේන්දරයකට උපන් වේලාව, ස්ථානය සහ ගණනය කිරීමේ ක්‍රමයක් අවශ්‍යය. මෙම පෙරදසුන ලග්නය හෝ නැකැත් ගණනය නොකරයි.
ඔබේ විශ්වාසයට ගැළපෙන නිහඬ මොහොතක් තෝරන්න. ශ්‍රී ලංකාවේ විවිධ ආගමික සම්ප්‍රදායන් එකම චාරිත්‍ර පද්ධතියක් ලෙස නොසැලකිය යුතුය.

name: Hoshi Note
intro: Small reflections, beneath a quiet sky.

en: Distinct ways of reflecting
Seiza horoscopes, eto zodiac traditions and omikuji fortune slips are different practices. Omikuji are associated with shrines and temples; this app is not an official shrine service.
A note for today
Write a short intention and revisit it this evening. It is a journal prompt, not an omikuji drawn at a shrine or a guaranteed forecast.
ja: それぞれの文化を大切に
星座占い、干支、おみくじは異なるものです。おみくじは神社や寺院に関わる文化で、このアプリは公式の神社サービスではありません。
今日の目標を短く書き、夜に振り返ってみましょう。これは日記のヒントであり、神社のおみくじや確実な予言ではありません。

name: Xing Light
intro: A thoughtful pause in a busy city.

en: A multicultural conversation
Singapore has many faiths and languages. Chinese zodiac celebrations form one cultural context, not a belief shared by everyone. Zodiac animals, BaZi and feng shui are different systems.
An intention for the season
Take a moment to record a hope for the season. The app does not calculate BaZi, recommend paid remedies or choose auspicious dates.
zh: 新加坡拥有多种信仰和语言。生肖庆祝活动是一种文化背景，并非所有人都持有相同信念。生肖、八字和风水是不同的体系。
花一点时间记录你的心愿。本应用不排八字、不推荐付费改运服务，也不选择吉日。

name: Csillag Út
intro: A quiet conversation, a clearer next step.

en: Your own relationship with astrology
This app uses a Western-zodiac theme. It does not claim that astrology is a national religion or that all Hungarians share the same rituals.
A moment to reflect
Write down a question and separate what you know from what you hope. This optional journaling exercise is not a historical Hungarian rite.
hu: Az alkalmazás a nyugati állatöv témáját használja. Nem állítja, hogy az asztrológia nemzeti vallás, vagy hogy minden magyar ugyanazokat a rítusokat követi.
Írj le egy kérdést, és válaszd külön, amit tudsz, attól, amit remélsz. Ez választható naplógyakorlat, nem történelmi magyar szertartás.
